blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱271.06 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱110.53 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Wednesday, Oct. 14, 2026. According to the PCSO results provided, the Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 10-54-08-35-34-38, with a jackpot prize of ₱271.06 million.
